scientific_integrity: Analytic argument from smooth invariant manifold and implicit-function theorem; exact symbolic identities and finite numerical checks supplement rather than prove the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed A,b,d>0 with b>A and small detuning; expansion is uniform on fixed compact y intervals, not at infinity. Rank-one scalar reduction and qualitative basin separation were already reported in earlier literature. The new quantitative coefficient has historical-priority uncertainty.
title: Quadratic curvature onset at the rank-one boundary of a competitive rational map
